description: 10 free tries a day here, then an Alion account (connect_account). What changed at companies, newest first: funding rounds, new countries and offices, technologies taken up or dropped, hiring spikes, a size band up, ATS adopted, leadership hires, first roles, hiring freezes and layoffs, launches, partnerships and customers won, awards, acquisitions, renames, accelerator batches, and Buying windows opened (a dated reason to buy). Across the graph narrowed by country, industry and size, or over up to 100 companies you name; since reaches back 90 days (default 7). Each row: the company card, the type, the day and what happened with its source. Poll it with next_cursor or follow it with watch_search kind=events. count_only is free. $0.005 an event. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

company.description: Only these companies: a domain, id or name, or a comma list of up to 100.

country.description: Headquarters country: ISO code or a comma list.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page; keep the other arguments identical.

industry.description: Industry by name, e.g. "Fintech", or a comma list.

since.description: An ISO date or a window ("24h", "7d", "2w"); at most 90 days back, default 7 days.

type.description: One type or a comma list: funding_round, geo_expansion, office_opened, technology_added, technology_dropped, hiring_spike, size_up, ats_adopted, leadership_hire, first_role, hiring_freeze, layoff, product_launch, part...
